comparison.objective: Candidate separates finishing media from washers using a screen; PR replaces a used cartridge in a ratchet-rod dispenser and restores the tool to working configuration.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests particle-flow control and retention during screen agitation; PR tests pawl disengagement, piston-rod retraction, cartridge exchange, seating, and re-engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires media recovery, retained washers, no spill/damage, and released support dwell; PR requires used-cartridge collection, replacement alignment, piston/pawl configuration, cradle placement, release, and 1 s stability, with escape causing permanent zero.
comparison.reason: Granular material separation is not cartridge replacement or passive mechanism reconfiguration; both records specify observable endpoint and loss conditions.
